headline: Two well-reviewed Asian concepts closed at an address with dense nearby competition.

hypotheses.reason: Intense local competition may have made it harder to stand out.
evidence: 85 Google venues and 42 FSA-listed venues within 150 m.
Nearby Blacklock has a 4.7 rating from 3,376 reviews; YAYACAS has 4.8 from 720 reviews.
Chingu’s fried-chicken offering overlaps with nearby Butchies.
hypotheses.counter_argument: Nanashi’s company existed for 42 months and its venue collected 285 reviews at 4.5 stars. The address can attract customers with the right positioning.

hypotheses.reason: Chingu may have struggled to build awareness and capture passing demand.
evidence: Chingu has 18 Google reviews at 4.6 stars; its company existed for 22 months.
Nanashi collected 285 reviews during a 42-month company lifespan.
76% of nearby venues open after 21:00 on weekdays; 77% open on Sundays.
hypotheses.counter_argument: Google marks Chingu temporarily closed, not permanently closed. Review volume does not directly measure revenue or delivery orders.

hypotheses.reason: Strong ratings alone may not have been enough in this neighbourhood.
evidence: The nearby Google rating median is 4.5; the median hygiene score is 5.
Nanashi’s 4.5 and Chingu’s 4.6 are near the local median, below leaders YAYACAS (4.8) and Blacklock (4.7).
hypotheses.counter_argument: Nearby Rotate operates with a lower 4.3 rating from 83 reviews, suggesting rating alone is not decisive.

caveat: Google traces both venues to this address, but Chingu is marked temporarily closed. The company-record timeline also has an unexplained 34-month gap. Company dates are not verified trading dates. Reasons for closure are hypotheses, not established facts.
